# Actions in api/admin.js that are routed BEFORE the requireAdmin() gate and are
# therefore reachable without any admin credential.
#
# Adding a line here is a security decision, not a formality. CI fails when a new
# unauthenticated action appears without being listed. Each entry must state who
# may call it and what limits protect it.
#
# reviewed: 2026-08-16

# --- intentionally public, read-only -------------------------------------
public-price          # landing + booking price tiers, no PII
public-discounts      # upcoming date discounts, no PII

# --- public writes, abuse-controlled by design ---------------------------
track-visit           # anonymous analytics ping — spoofable, see advisory 10

# --- guest-reachable, spends money: MUST get real quota control ----------
placement-status      # daily quota lookup keyed by client-supplied visitor_id
placement-transcribe  # OpenAI speech-to-text, no attempt recorded — advisory 03
placement-score       # OpenAI scoring — advisory 03
placement-history     # past guest results by visitor_id

# --- customer-authenticated inside the handler (token checked in body) ---
progress-status
progress-score
progress-history
notifications
community
chat
account-badges
